comments.body: Root cause confirmed on current main: existing creeps already acquire opposing creeps, route through AI/nav when nav data exists, attack survivors/Core, and feed existing match resolution; the Lane War feature configured exactly one WaveDirector wave, while WaveDirector stopped after its final configured wave. #2446 fixes only that gap by making WaveDirector looping opt-in and enabling it for Lane War. Exact head b31ea02c adds an engine regression for loop-back lifecycle; focused source contract 1/1 and diff-check passed. Hosted gate is running; runtime acceptance remains required.

#2603 publishes a small player-visible lane-pressure readout on Core labels: replicated wave state now distinguishes forming, spawning, live/resolving and failed pressure and shows active creep count plus push/defend guidance. Original focused head: core-team-beacon contracts 19/19 PASS + diff-check; refreshed head 1025d235b4f8ff004e7bd50f8907706824467d0a has the same scoped file content because main changed only unrelated combat files, and its hosted contract gate is SUCCESS. Native P3Gameplay admission was refused LOW_FREE_DISK, so no native/runtime PASS is claimed.

Current-main read at 47e1cf1e3 found a remaining no-path recovery gap in P3TowerDefenseCombatActors.cpp: with nav data present, Lane War creeps call AIController::MoveToActor every tick but ignore the request result and have no OnMoveCompleted/no-path branch; direct movement is deliberately disabled whenever nav data exists. A nav failure can therefore leave a creep indefinitely reissuing a failed move instead of using a declared recovery policy. This is distinct from the #2440 placement rollback guard and matches #2437's pending/no-path acceptance. Next implementation should handle the existing AI move result at this owner (reacquire/wait/recover under an explicit policy) and prove it in the normal Lane War route-change sequence; no runtime PASS claimed here.

Addendum from the same current-main path: ResolveLaneWarCombatTarget retains any hostile creep within 700 cm and acquires the nearest within 500 cm using distance/height only; it does not test reachability. Combined with the ignored MoveToActor result, an unreachable nearby enemy creep can pin RouteTarget indefinitely even when the Core route itself is valid. A narrow fix should therefore make failed path admission invalidate/reconsider the creep target before falling back to Core pressure, without ever using the direct-motion fallback while nav data exists. This also avoids copying P3LaneWarSoloAIController's current MoveToActor pattern, which likewise does not implement no-path recovery.

#2630 addresses the current no-path pin: when AI path admission rejects a nearby hostile creep, the creep target is cleared immediately and the same authoritative creep retries only the enemy Core route; direct-motion fallback remains reserved for worlds with no nav data. Final head 2352f0e5 strengthens the source contract to pin failed-path -> Core retry ordering before the no-nav fallback. Focused contract 2/2 PASS, diff-check PASS, hosted contract gate SUCCESS. Native P3TowerDefense compile first found/fixed the enum-definition include at 0986bbbd; the one changed-head re-admission then hit the shared build-slot timeout, so native/runtime PASS remains unclaimed.

Aspen #2634 exact head 9ae592757 implements the narrow no-path recovery identified above: with nav data present, TickLaneWarRoute now inspects MoveToActor admission; an immediate failure against a hostile creep clears that unreachable creep target and retries the enemy Core through the same AI/nav path. The no-nav direct-motion fallback is unchanged and remains gated to missing nav data. Focused navigation fallback + creep-pressure contracts 3/3 PASS; diff-check PASS. UE 5.8 path-request enum/header contract was verified and included explicitly. Native/build proof was not retried because this run's OMEN condition remains LOW_FREE_DISK.

Alder #2644 exact head f3916d6a makes the no-nav direct creep fallback collision-safe: SetActorLocation now sweeps instead of teleporting, so walls/terrain can physically stop fallback pressure rather than being tunneled through. Normal nav-data movement remains AI-owned. Focused road-routing 6/6 + navigation-fallback 1/1 PASS; diff-check PASS. Hosted gate is queued, so no merge/runtime PASS claimed. Duplicate no-path PR #2642 was closed after current issue comments exposed existing stronger #2630/#2634 WIP; #2634 was then closed in favor of #2630's stronger ordering contract/header fix.

Current-main routing progress: #2644 merged as e00072bdd6fd so the no-nav direct fallback now sweeps collision instead of teleporting through blockers; #2630 then merged cleanly as f61974b92168 so a nav-rejected nearby hostile target is cleared and creep pressure retries the enemy Core route instead of reissuing the same failed MoveToActor forever. Existing fresh focused evidence was 6/6 road + 1/1 nav-fallback for #2644 and 2/2 nav-fallback for #2630; no runtime PASS claimed.

title: [GAMEPLAY] Lane War creep pressure and Core assault
